questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates multi-region deployment strategies, tenant-aware traffic routing, and production-grade safety controls for an intermediate DevOps engineer role.

## Key Concepts
- Blue/Green deployments across Azure regions
- Azure Front Door per-tenant routing
- Progressive canary rollout by tenant
- Gate enforcement with Azure Policy + OPA
- Drift detection against ARM templates
- Automatic rollback to blue on failure
- Comprehensive logging to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  blueRegion: 'eastus'
  greenRegion: 'westus2'
  canaryPercentage: 1

stages:
  - stage: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyGate
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
          - task: Bash@3
            name: 'OPAValidation'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                opa eval --input tenant-config.json --format json --fail-defined-fail data.policies.deny data.policies.warn

  - stage: DeployBlue
    dependsOn: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToBlueRegion
        environment: 'blue-$(blueRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-blue'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-blue.json'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  name: 'RunSmokeTests'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az functionapp test run --name api-blue --test-type smoke
                      
  - stage: DeployGreen
    dependsOn: DeployBlue
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToGreenRegion
        environment: 'green-$(greenRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-green'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-green.json'
                
  - stage: CanaryRollout
    dependsOn: DeployGreen
    variables:
      tenantList: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/tenants/tenant-list.json'
    jobs:
      - job: PromoteCanary
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RouteCanaryTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANTS=$(jq -r '.tenants | length * 0.01 | floor' $(tenantList))
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name canary-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --route-type Performance \
                  --pattern '/*'
                  --backend-pool-name canary-pool
                  
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            name: 'CheckCanaryMetrics'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              ResourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              alertRules:
                - alertName: 'CanaryErrorRate'
                  condition: 'avg(errorRate) > 5'
                  action: 'fail'
          
  - stage: ProductionPromotion
    dependsOn: CanaryRollout
    condition: succeeded('CanaryRollout')
    jobs:
      - job: UpdateFrontDoorRouting
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'SwitchTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name green-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'DriftCheck'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group compare \
                  --resource-group $(rgName)-green \
                  --template-file templates/api-green.json
                  
  - stage: Rollback
    dependsOn: ProductionPromotion
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: RollbackToBlue
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RevertTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name blue-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'NotifyFailure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor alert create \
                  --name pipeline-failure \
                  --resource-group $(rgName) \
                  --description 'Blue/Green deployment failed - rolled back to blue'
```

**Pipeline Flow Summary**

1. **Pre-Deploy Validation** - Azure Policy gate and OPA policy validation before any deployment
2. **Deploy Blue** - Deploy to blue region with smoke tests
3. **Deploy Green** - Deploy to green region for canary testing
4. **Canary Rollout** - Route 1% of tenants to green, monitor metrics
5. **Production Promotion** - Switch Front Door to green, run drift detection
6. **Automatic Rollback** - On failure, revert Front Door to blue and notify

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests a realistic, beginner-friendly pipeline that covers core Azure DevOps tasks: CI, Docker, ACR, App Service slots, App Configuration integration, health-based swap, and Log Analytics auditing.

## Key Concepts

- YAML pipelines and multi-stage design
- Docker build/push to Azure Container Registry
- Azure App Service deployment slots (staging/production) and slot swap
- Azure App Configuration for per-environment flags
- Health checks and rollback strategies
- Logging/auditing to Azure Monitor / Log Analytics
- Service connections and least-privilege access

## Code Example

```yaml
trigger:
- main
pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest
variables:
  imageName: myapi
  registry: <ACR_NAME>.azurecr.io
stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: Test
    steps:
    - task: NodeTool@0
      inputs: {version: '18.x'}
    - script: npm install
    - script: npm test
- stage: Deploy
  jobs:
  - job: Deploy
    steps:
    - task: Docker@2
      inputs:
        command: buildAndPush
        containerRegistry: '<registry-service-connection>'
        repository: '$(registry)/$(imageName)'
        Dockerfile: '**/Dockerfile'
        tags: |
          $(Build.BuildId)
    - task: AzureWebAppContainer@1
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '<subscription-connection>'
        appName: '<app-service-name>'
        imageName: '$(registry)/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)'
        resourceGroup: '<rg>'
        slotName: 'staging'
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '<subscription-connection>'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        script: |
          HEALTH_URL=https://<app-service-name>-staging.azurewebsites.net/health
          if curl -sSf $HEALTH_URL | grep -q 'ok'; then
            az webapp deployment slot swap --resource-group <rg> --name <app-service-name> --slot staging --target-slot production
          else
            az webapp deployment slot swap --resource-group <rg> --name <app-service-name> --slot production --target-slot staging
            exit 1
          fi
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you add a retry policy for the health check without masking failures?
- How would you extend this to support a blue/green rollout for multiple regions?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates foundational CI/CD knowledge including pipeline configuration, artifact management, and release governance with security controls.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML configuration and triggers
- Python environment setup with version 3.11
- Test execution with pytest and coverage reporting
- Wheel package building and artifact publishing
- Release environments with manual approval gates
- Security scanning integration for production deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure Pipelines YAML for Python CI/CD
trigger:
  - main
pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: 'Build and Test Stage'
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'
      displayName: 'Use Python $(pythonVersion)'
    
    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    
    - script: |
        pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
      displayName: 'Run tests with coverage'
    
    - script: |
        python setup.py bdist_wheel
      displayName: 'Build wheel package'
    
    - task: PublishBuildArtifacts@1
      inputs:
        pathToPublish: 'dist'
        artifactName: 'python-wheel'
      displayName: 'Publish wheel artifact'

- stage: Release
  displayName: 'Release to Production'
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToProd
    displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
    environment: 'Production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: DownloadBuildArtifacts@0
            inputs:
              buildType: 'current'
              downloadType: 'single'
              artifactName: 'python-wheel'
              downloadPath: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)'
          
          - task: AntiMalware@3
            inputs:
              InputType: 'Basic'
              ScanDirectory: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)/python-wheel'
            displayName: 'Security scan'
          
          - script: |
              echo 'Deploying to production...'
            displayName: 'Deploy to production'
```

## Implementation Notes
- The pipeline triggers on both push and PR to main branch
- Uses Python 3.11 with proper dependency management
- Includes comprehensive testing with pytest and coverage reporting
- Builds and publishes wheel package as build artifact
- Production deployment requires manual approval through environment
- Built-in security scanning (AntiMalware) before production promotion
- Follows Azure DevOps best practices for stage-based deployment

## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of multi-tenant deployments, progressive canaries, and policy-driven gates across Azure DevOps, Key Vault, App Configuration, and OPA.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant release tracking and canary progression
- Slot-based deployments and targeted rollback
- Secrets management with Azure Key Vault and feature flags via App Configuration
- Policy gates with Azure Policy + OPA and budget tagging
- Observability with Azure Monitor / Log Analytics

## Code Example
```yaml
# Simplified snippet illustrating tenant-aware canary stages
stages:
  - stage: Canary
    jobs:
      - job: DeployCanary
        steps:
          - script: echo Deploying 10% tenants to staging slot
          - script: ./deploy-per-tenant.ps1 --percent 10 --slot staging
  - stage: Validate
    dependsOn: Canary
    jobs:
      - job: Tests
        steps:
          - script: ./run-synthetic-tests.ps1 --perTenant
  - stage: Promote
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: PromoteAll
        steps:
          - script: ./promote-all.tenants.ps1
```
